thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: prod/inference - sudden token-latency spike detected on cluster us-west-2 (sev=2). Paging @oncall-eric and #incidents. brief: 99th p90 spike 3x baseline; error surface minimal, requests slowed. automated fallback to smaller model triggered.

Eric (on-call): here, seeing high tail latency on gpu-pool-b. digging into batching queues and kernel timeouts. starting mitigation: draining a node and shifting traffic to warm pool.

Ben H: noted. I can bump dedicated capacity in the short-term (scale +2 instances) and revert batching config if needed. pulling logs now.

Alice K: tagging customer impact — two midsize tenants saw timeouts for ~4-6 minutes. Support already triaging. Need a quick status summary for account owners once we stabilize.

Zoe - Support: thanks. I've opened a ticket with affected customers (INC-8592). Drafted an acknowledgement: "We're investigating an inference latency issue affecting requests since 14:07 UTC. We're mitigating and will share updates." want a short timeline once you confirm mitigation.

Eric (on-call): mitigation in progress: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-12 && kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — draining succeeded, traffic rebalanced. Early metrics look better. p50 normal, p95 improving but p99 still elevated.

incident-bot: Update: mitigation action detected (node drain). Rolling fallback to smaller model continues (10% of requests).

Ben H: I flipped autoscale to manual and added two instances. Also reverted grouping config to `batch_size: 8`. We'll keep an eye for 10m.

Sara M: nice. Can we get a post-incident runbook + timeline? I want to schedule an internal postmortem and a customer-facing follow-up. Tentative PM/Eng meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Who can own the RCA draft?

Eric (on-call): I'm happy to lead the RCA inventory for infra side — will collect kernel traces, queue metrics, and the node-level logs. Need someone from model infra to check runtime change impacts (Ben?).

Ben H: I can validate the batching/runtime flags and run a repro on staging. Will also include the autoscaler decision timeline.

Alice K: I'll compile customer impact notes and pull the support tickets. Suggest we prepare two artifacts: (1) internal timeline + root cause hypotheses, (2) a concise customer note and an exec summary for Sales. Draft customer note should avoid technical detail but commit to next steps and ETA for RCA.

Zoe - Support: suggested customer note draft: "At 14:07 UTC we observed increased inference latency for a subset of requests. We mitigated the issue within ~9 minutes by rebalancing capacity and applying a fallback model. We're investigating the root cause and will share a detailed report by EOD tomorrow. If you saw errors, please reply to INC-8592 with request ids." happy to send once we have the approved timeline + RCA link. :thumbsup:

Nim P: I'm booking the postmortem: internal session tomorrow 16:00 UTC (30m), invite: Eng-runtime, Eng-infra, Support, PMs, and SRE. Please add any additional stakeholders. Also creating a follow-up sprint for remediation items; want owners and ETA in the meeting.

Eric (on-call): initial findings: a rare kernel slowdown aligned with a large minibatch from tenant X. There's an observable spike in `cuda_kernel_time` at 14:06:53 across the node. Attaching quick log snippet for triage:```
[14:06:53] gpu-node-12 kernel: kernel_exec_time=1284ms on stream-7
[14:06:54] gpu-node-12 queue: request_queue_depth=48
[14:07:01] fallback: model-variant-small routed 10% requests
```

Ben H: thanks — I'll try to reproduce with synthetic load next hour. Can someone check if recent runtime patch (deployed 3 days ago) touched batching heuristics?

Sara M: I'll coordinate the RCA doc. Proposed sections: summary, timeline, impact, root cause analysis, mitigation, follow-ups, customer communication. We need an owner for follow-up tasks: e.g., "Investigate kernel regression" (owner=Ben), "Improve fallback automation and SLA for scaling" (owner=Eric), "Customer comms and exec note" (owner=Alice).

Alice K: confirmed owner for customer comms (me). I propose the customer note to be published to status page and sent via account teams after we finalize the timeline. For status page entry I recommend: short blurb, impact window, mitigation, and pointer to RCA once ready. Example blurb: "Between 14:07–14:16 UTC we observed elevated inference latency affecting a subset of requests in us-west-2. We mitigated by rebalancing capacity and applying a fallback; full service restored. A detailed RCA will be shared."

Zoe - Support: +1. If we want to pre-share a short status-page entry before full RCA, I'll coordinate the publish and set visibility to affected customers only. We usually wait for internal PM signoff.

Nim P: good plan. For sprinting remediation, suggest we create issues with these acceptance criteria: reproduce on staging, add guardrails to avoid the large single-minibatch impact, tighten fallback thresholds to reduce customer-facing errors. Let's capture estimates in tomorrow's postmortem and aim for a P1 sprint within 2 weeks.

Eric (on-call): action items I have so far:
- collect node-level traces + kernel dumps (due: today EOD)
- add a short-term alert refinement to detect sudden kernel slowdowns (owner: Eric, due: 48h)
- coordinate with Ben on repro (owner: Ben, due: 72h)

Ben H: my action items:
- run synthetic repro with the minibatch pattern (due: 48h)
- audit runtime changes from last 7 days (due: 24h)
- PR for safer default batching config if repro succeeds (owner: Ben, due: 1 week)

Alice K: customer-related actions:
- final customer note + status page entry (due: tomorrow EOD)
- coordinate account team sends and exec blurb (owner: Alice, due: tomorrow EOD)

Zoe - Support: I'll hold on sending until Alice confirms. I'll also add all affected request IDs to ticket INC-8592.

Sara M: I'll own the RCA doc skeleton and set up the doc link in the calendar invite. Please drop logs, traces, and dev notes in the doc before the meeting.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to sev=3 — tail latency improving, p99 trending back to baseline.

Ben H: p99 looks stable at +10% vs baseline now. I'll keep the extra instances for 3 more hours then re-evaluate.

Eric (on-call): thanks everyone. Final ask before we close this thread: please add any blockers or items you'd like on the postmortem agenda. If no objections, we'll publish the short status page entry tomorrow morning and the full RCA after the internal review.

Alice K: no blockers from my side. I'll draft the status-page blurb and post here for quick review before publish.

Nim P: great — see you in the postmortem. We'll track remediation work in the "inference-remediation" sprint board.

Zoe - Support: copied. I'll update customers once Alice posts the approved blurb. :white_check_mark:
